For JMB/MC, corporations and asset owners: we assess and rate the condition of every building element — structure, fabric, services and finishes — producing a clear picture of current condition, defect priorities and maintenance budgeting.

What's included

  • Element-by-element condition survey & rating
  • Structural, fabric & M&E assessment
  • Defect prioritisation matrix
  • Maintenance & CAPEX budget guidance
  • Compliance-oriented documentation

What you receive

  • Prioritised defect register
  • Maintenance planning input

Our Methodology

4 Stages of a Condition Assessment

A systematic, documented process — the same standard applied to every building we assess

1

Scoping & Records Review

We agree the scope with you and review drawings, past reports and maintenance records

2

Systematic Site Survey

Element-by-element survey with calibrated instruments and full photo documentation

3

Rating & Prioritisation

Each element rated on our scale, then ranked by urgency and consequence of failure

4

Report & Budget Guidance

Full report with the defect register, repair recommendations and maintenance budget input

Rating Scale

Every Element Given a Condition Rating

No vague opinions — each element is rated on a consistent scale you can act on

Good

Sound condition — routine maintenance only

Fair

Minor deterioration — monitor and plan ahead

Poor

Significant defects — repair required within the near term

Critical

Immediate action — safety or structural risk present
